    • Method Detail

      • getUniqueId

        java.util.UUID getUniqueId()
        UUID-based identifier for the player. This refers to the player's uuid
        Returns:
        UUID of the player

      • getUsername

        java.lang.String getUsername()
        This is usually equivalent to HumanEntity.getName() but this is cached and saved along with match data, so it can be different if the player changed their name.
        Returns:
        The username of the player

      • getSkin

        xyz.refinedev.api.skin.data.CachedSkin getSkin()
        The skin data of this player This skin is used for bots and spectators to see the correct skin of the player
        Returns:
        CachedSkin of the player

      • getEntities

        java.util.List<org.bukkit.entity.Entity> getEntities()
        The entities launched or thrown by this player.
        Returns:
        List of entities

      • getBedLocations

        @Nullable
@Nullable java.util.List<org.bukkit.Location> getBedLocations()
        If the match is a bed fight match, this will return the both locations of the bed block of this player's team. If this match is not a bed fight match, this will return null. This can also return null if the map was not setup properly.
        Returns:
        List of Location or null

      • getSpawn

        @Nullable
@Nullable org.bukkit.Location getSpawn()
        The spawn location of this player in the match. This is usually the spawn point of their team. Can be null if the player has not spawned yet.
        Returns:
        Location of the spawn point

      • isAlive

        boolean isAlive()
        Returns true if the player is alive in the match. This can be false while the player is respawning.
        Returns:
        true if the player is alive

      • isDisconnected

        boolean isDisconnected()
        Returns true if the player has disconnected from the match. This can be either from leaving the server or executing /leave.
        Returns:
        true if the player has disconnected

      • isForfeited

        boolean isForfeited()
        Returns true if the player has forfeited the match. This is set to true when the player executes /leave.
        Returns:
        true if the player has forfeited

      • isKitSelected

        boolean isKitSelected()
        Has the player selected a player kit? This will always return false if the player does not have any custom kits.
        Returns:
        true if the player has selected a kit

      • isBot

        boolean isBot()
        Is this player a bot? Can also be checked if the Player object has a "boltNPC" metadata.
        Returns:
        true if the player is a bot

      • isHasBed

        boolean isHasBed()
        Does the player still have their bed?
        Returns:
        true if the player has their bed

      • getCoinsEarned

        int getCoinsEarned()
        The coins earned by this player during the match. This is calculated based on kills, wins, and other factors.
        Returns:
        int of coins earned

      • setCoinsEarned

        void setCoinsEarned(int coinsEarned)
        Sets the coins earned by this player during the match.
        Parameters:
        coinsEarned - int of coins earned

      • getSelectedKit

        @Nullable
@Nullable IKitInventory getSelectedKit()
        The kit selected by this player. This can be null if the player has not selected a kit. If the player does not have any custom kits, this will always be null.
        Returns:
        IKitInventory or null

      • setSelectedKit

        void setSelectedKit(@Nullable
                    @Nullable IKitInventory kitInventory)
        Sets the kit selected by this player. When the player spawns in the match, if this is not null then this kit will always be applied. Coloring of the contents if automatically handled, if the kit is a color based kit.
        Parameters:
        kitInventory - IKitInventory or null

      • getPoints

        int getPoints()
        Points scored by this player in the match. This is usually used for goal based game modes. Like portal kits or mlg rush.
        Returns:
        int of points scored

      • setPoints

        void setPoints(int points)
        Sets the points scored by this player in the match.
        Parameters:
        points - int of points scored

      • getLives

        int getLives()
        Lives remaining for this player in the match. This is usually used for matches with limited lives like Pearl Fight.
        Returns:
        int of lives remaining

      • setLives

        void setLives(int lives)
        Sets the lives remaining for this player in the match.
        Parameters:
        lives - int of lives remaining
